text:
sqlpipe is a command-line tool that syncs Postgres tables to S3 as Parquet files. It reads the tables that you list in the configuration file. Then it writes each table to an S3 bucket as one or more Parquet files. You can run a full sync or an incremental sync. An incremental sync copies only the rows that changed after the last sync.

sqlpipe is one binary with no external dependencies. It connects to Postgres through a standard connection string. It writes Parquet files that tools such as Athena, DuckDB, and Spark can read. You can run a sync from the command line or from a scheduler such as cron.
